proposed.title: Catalog::open drops a replaced dataset under the write guard: a latency note, with Catalog::remove's doc drift (weekly window (d), S2)
proposed.summary: RULED 2026-09-26, question round 25, item 1 (d): S2 on the reproduction's outcome (state/consults/2026-09-26-catalog-open-drop-reproduction.md). No Drop reached from the replaced dataset acquires, or waits on a thread waiting for, the catalog lock. The replaced dataset's DuckDB teardown does run under the write guard: the replaced value is a temporary dropped before the guard (the report's probe (a)). No product path replaces a dataset today: SKP opens under a fresh handle and slice-host opens once. If taken, the fix is #116's shape, binding the replaced value and dropping it after the guard is released. Also: Catalog::remove's doc says a live stream's Arc<Dataset> keeps the dataset alive, and the report finds no stream that holds one (its section 3).
